answer: Hold every reward in escrow for several epochs, then release it only after a random spot-check by graders drawn from outside the earner's recent contacts. A sybil farm can fake agreement once, but each clone must survive an audit it cannot predict or steer, and a failed check claws back the whole batch. Like cracking a walnut to see if the kernel is real, the audit looks past the polished ivory surface of high scores to the work underneath, so mass-produced identities become a liability instead of income.
